stories.headline: Kamara's Horse Comes Up Lame, and Etienne Just Inherited the Whole Ranch
stories.read: Well pardner, Alvin Kamara took a spill in a joint practice against the Cowboys and sprained his MCL, and the word from the wire is he's laid up at least a month, maybe longer if New Orleans stashes him on IR to start the year. That's a real shot to a fella already fighting for touches after the Saints paid Travis Etienne Jr. forty-eight million dollars this spring. Etienne just became the lead horse in that backfield with nobody riding shotgun, and he's still priced like a committee back in most saloons. Go stake that claim before the herd catches up.

stories.headline: Higgins Busts a Wheel in Vegas, and the Texans' Wagon Just Got Lighter
stories.read: Hold up there. Texans wideout Jayden Higgins tore his ACL in a joint practice against the Raiders and he's done for the whole season, no ifs about it. That's a gut punch for a Houston receiving room that leaned on him as the No. 2 behind Nico Collins, and it opens real dirt for Xavier Hutchinson and Jaylin Noel to grab a bigger cut of the throws. One of those fellas is about to become cheap gold on the open range come September, so keep your eyes on how camp sorts the pecking order.

stories.headline: Pearsall Goes Under the Knife, and Niners Camp Just Lost a Starter for the Year
stories.read: Straight from the wire, pardner: Ricky Pearsall finally had that nagging PCL fixed for good, and John Lynch confirmed he's out the entire 2026 season. That leaves Kyle Shanahan's passing attack short a starting receiver right as camp winds down, and it hands Jauan Jennings and the rest of that room a bigger stake in the offense. If you're huntin' a diamond in the rough in San Francisco's pass game, this is the vein that just opened up.
